name: HOG Gateway for CVP

scope.static_pages: GitHub Pages continues to serve the public presentation, PDFs, image, and public JSON without requiring HOG.
scope.authenticated_services: Use HOG only if separately hosted CVP APIs, login, private archive services, or a remotely accessible Hermes Gateway need an authenticated ingress.
scope.deployment_status: No HOG source, container image, hog.yaml, Compose stack, identity provider, API, or node has been deployed by this proposal.

public_ingress.forwards_to_hog_over: private network; use TLS/mTLS if this hop is not otherwise trusted

frontend_gateway.replicas: N identical replicas, if supported by the selected HOG release
frontend_gateway.role: OIDC authorization-code flow and browser session
frontend_gateway.session: sealed stateless cookie by default; optional opaque ID backed by a TTL StateStore when configured

api_verification_gateway.replicas: N identical replicas, if supported by the selected HOG release
api_verification_gateway.role: verify bearer access tokens before protected APIs

backend_services: CVP API, if implemented and deployed
Hermes Gateway and Hermes Agent, if separately installed, configured, and deployed
Kubo API on a restricted private/local network

hermes_gateway.role: Optional channel/HTTP entry point to the Hermes Agent; distinct from HOG.
hermes_gateway.local_api_default: Bind to loopback unless remote access is intentionally configured.
hermes_gateway.external_channels: Enable only by choice; messaging platforms and external tools can send prompts or data off-device.

trusted_proxies.production_rule: Configure only the exact immediate ingress/load-balancer peer IPs or CIDRs after confirming header sanitization.
trusted_proxies.header_stripping: Treat forwarded headers as untrusted unless the immediate peer is in the trusted-proxy allowlist.

trust_boundaries.identity_assertions: Accept forwarded identity assertions only over a protected authenticated gateway-to-backend hop; validate token issuer, audience, signature, allowed algorithm, expiry, and relevant claims.
trust_boundaries.ai_agency: HOG/Hermes gateway authentication is not agent authorization; require explicit approval for writes, code execution, external network access, IPFS publication, signing, OS changes, and GitHub publication.
trust_boundaries.private_keys_and_tokens: Do not pass signing keys, OIDC secrets, session keys, or access tokens into model prompts or public CVP records.

state_provider.store_contract: encrypted key-value records with TTL; selected plugin must be reviewed
state_provider.backend_dependency: Introduces shared session storage, not a shared gateway control plane.
state_provider.failure_policy: Fail closed on unreadable or unavailable session state, as specified by the HOG documentation.

observability.otlp_export: disabled unless an operator configures an endpoint

verification_required_before_use: inspect source and versioned configuration schema
verify build stages, supported compiler/base image, and published image digest
review plugins, SBOM, and security update policy
test read-only/non-root operation and required writable paths

protocol_limits: Stateless gateway replicas do not create global archive consensus or first-writer-wins ordering.
HOG ingress does not centralize the current browser-local CVP archive or its signing key.
A content CID does not guarantee that content remains available.
This topology does not establish identity, legal jurisdiction, ownership, patent rights, or legal effect.
